title: 自定义 Layout Protocol 实战
html:
自定义 Layout Protocol 实战

核心概念

iOS 16 引入的 Layout 协议（SE-0396）是 SwiftUI 布局系统的底层接口——HStack、VStack、ZStack 内部都遵循同一协议。开发者现在可以实现自定义容器布局：瀑布流（Masonry）、径向菜单（Radial）、标签自动换行（Flow）等任何排列逻辑。Layout Protocol 的核心是两阶段协商模型：sizeThatFits 报告容器自身尺寸，placeSubviews 决定每个子视图的位置和大小。

sequenceDiagram
    participant Parent as 父容器
    participant Layout as 自定义 Layout
    participant Child as 子视图

    Parent->>Layout: sizeThatFits(proposal)
    Layout->>Child: subview.sizeThatFits(childProposal)
    Child-->>Layout: 子视图理想尺寸
    Layout-->>Parent: 容器尺寸
    Parent->>Layout: placeSubviews(bounds, proposal)
    Layout->>Child: subview.place(at:, proposal:)
协议方法 职责 调用时机
sizeThatFits(proposal:subviews:cache:) 根据子视图尺寸计算容器尺寸 父容器需要知道本容器大小时
placeSubviews(in:proposal:subviews:cache:) 将子视图放置到具体坐标 布局阶段，bounds 已确定
makeCache(subviews:) 创建跨两阶段共享的缓存 布局开始前
spacing(subviews:cache:) 声明容器与相邻视图的间距偏好 父容器计算间距时

Flow Layout（标签自动换行）

最常见的自定义布局需求是让子视图从左到右排列，超出宽度自动换行：

struct FlowLayout: Layout {
    var spacing: CGFloat = 8

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let maxWidth = proposal.width ?? .infinity
        var currentX: CGFloat = 0
        var currentY: CGFloat = 0
        var lineHeight: CGFloat = 0
        var totalHeight: CGFloat = 0

        for subview in subviews {
            let size = subview.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            if currentX + size.width > maxWidth, currentX > 0 {
                currentX = 0
                currentY += lineHeight + spacing
                lineHeight = 0
            }
            currentX += size.width + spacing
            lineHeight = max(lineHeight, size.height)
        }
        totalHeight = currentY + lineHeight

        return CGSize(width: maxWidth, height: totalHeight)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        var currentX = bounds.minX
        var currentY = bounds.minY
        var lineHeight: CGFloat = 0

        for subview in subviews {
            let size = subview.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            if currentX + size.width > bounds.maxX, currentX > bounds.minX {
                currentX = bounds.minX
                currentY += lineHeight + spacing
                lineHeight = 0
            }
            subview.place(at: CGPoint(x: currentX, y: currentY), proposal: .unspecified)
            currentX += size.width + spacing
            lineHeight = max(lineHeight, size.height)
        }
    }
}

使用方式完全声明式：

FlowLayout(spacing: 6) {
    ForEach(tags) { tag in
        TagView(tag: tag)
    }
}

Radial Layout（径向布局）

将子视图均匀分布在圆弧上：

struct RadialLayout: Layout {
    var radius: CGFloat = 100
    var startAngle: Angle = .zero

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let diameter = radius * 2 + 60
        return CGSize(width: diameter, height: diameter)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        let count = subviews.count
        guard count > 0 else { return }
        let angleStep = Angle.degrees(360.0 / Double(count))
        let center = CGPoint(x: bounds.midX, y: bounds.midY)

        for (index, subview) in subviews.enumerated() {
            let angle = startAngle + angleStep * Double(index)
            let x = center.x + radius * cos(angle.radians)
            let y = center.y + radius * sin(angle.radians)
            subview.place(at: CGPoint(x: x, y: y), anchor: .center, proposal: .unspecified)
        }
    }
}

Layout Cache 优化

当子视图数量较多时，两阶段都需要遍历子视图计算尺寸，造成重复开销。makeCache 允许预计算结果在 sizeThatFits 和 placeSubviews 之间共享：

struct MasonryLayout: Layout {
    var columns: Int = 2
    var spacing: CGFloat = 8

    struct CacheData {
        var columnHeights: [CGFloat]
        var childSizes: [CGSize]
    }

    func makeCache(subviews: Subviews) -> CacheData {
        let sizes = subviews.map { $0.sizeThatFits(.unspecified) }
        return CacheData(columnHeights: Array(repeating: 0, count: columns), childSizes: sizes)
    }

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout CacheData) -> CGSize {
        let width = proposal.width ?? 300
        let colWidth = (width - spacing * CGFloat(columns - 1)) / CGFloat(columns)
        cache.columnHeights = Array(repeating: 0, count: columns)

        for size in cache.childSizes {
            let shortest = cache.columnHeights.enumerated().min(by: { $0.element < $1.element })!.offset
            cache.columnHeights[shortest] += size.height + spacing
        }
        return CGSize(width: width, height: cache.columnHeights.max() ?? 0)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout CacheData) {
        let colWidth = (bounds.width - spacing * CGFloat(columns - 1)) / CGFloat(columns)
        var heights = Array(repeating: CGFloat(0), count: columns)

        for (index, subview) in subviews.enumerated() {
            let col = heights.enumerated().min(by: { $0.element < $1.element })!.offset
            let x = bounds.minX + CGFloat(col) * (colWidth + spacing)
            let y = bounds.minY + heights[col]
            subview.place(at: CGPoint(x: x, y: y), proposal: ProposedViewSize(width: colWidth, height: nil))
            heights[col] += cache.childSizes[index].height + spacing
        }
    }
}

ViewThatFits 自适应布局

ViewThatFits 尝试多个候选布局，使用第一个在可用空间内 fits 的版本：

ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
    // 首选：图标 + 文字
    Label("下载文件", systemImage: "arrow.down.circle")
    // 备选：仅图标
    Image(systemName: "arrow.down.circle")
}

配合自定义 Layout 实现响应式容器：

ViewThatFits {
    HStack { content }  // 横向放得下就横排
    VStack { content }  // 否则纵排
}

AnyLayout 动态切换

在运行时根据条件切换布局类型：

struct AdaptiveView: View {
    @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass) var sizeClass

    var body: some View {
        let layout = sizeClass == .compact
            ? AnyLayout(VStackLayout(spacing: 12))
            : AnyLayout(HStackLayout(spacing: 20))

        layout {
            ForEach(items) { item in
                ItemView(item: item)
            }
        }
    }
}

小结

  • Layout Protocol 暴露了 SwiftUI 布局引擎的两阶段协商模型（sizeThatFits + placeSubviews）
  • 自定义布局可实现 Flow、Masonry、Radial 等非标排列，完全声明式使用
  • Cache 机制避免两阶段重复计算子视图尺寸
  • ViewThatFits 和 AnyLayout 提供响应式和动态布局切换能力
  • 自定义 Layout 与动画系统协作良好——布局变化自动参与过渡动画
